lines.say: Goo-rah Goo-rah no Mee. The Tremor-Tremor Fruit. A fruit said to have the power to destroy the world.
lines.show: Gura Gura no Mi. The Tremor-Tremor Fruit. A fruit said to have the power to destroy the world.

lines.say: It's a Paramecia fruit, and it's widely called the strongest Paramecia of them all.
lines.show: It's a Paramecia fruit, and it's widely called the strongest Paramecia of them all.

lines.say: Its user was Edward Newgate. Whitebeard. The Strongest Man in the World.
lines.show: Its user was Edward Newgate. Whitebeard. The Strongest Man in the World.

lines.say: With one punch, he could crack the air itself, like a pane of glass.
lines.show: With one punch, he could crack the air itself, like a pane of glass.

lines.say: Those cracks became shockwaves. And the shockwaves became earthquakes.
lines.show: Those cracks became shockwaves. And the shockwaves became earthquakes.

lines.say: Hit the sea floor, and the quake turns into a giant tsunami.
lines.show: Hit the sea floor, and the quake turns into a giant tsunami.

lines.say: In the war at Marineford, one quake tilted the entire island, and the sea around it.
lines.show: In the war at Marineford, one quake tilted the entire island, and the sea around it.

lines.say: He took hundreds of wounds, and died standing. Not a single scar on his back. He never ran.
lines.show: He took hundreds of wounds, and died standing. Not a single scar on his back. He never ran.

lines.say: His last words shook the world too. The One Piece is real!
lines.show: His last words shook the world too. "The One Piece is real!"

lines.say: Then Blackbeard stepped in, and by means nobody knows, took the quake power for himself.
lines.show: Then Blackbeard stepped in, and by means nobody knows, took the quake power for himself.

lines.say: Now he's the only known person in history with the powers of two devil fruits.
lines.show: Now he's the only known person in history with the powers of two devil fruits.

lines.say: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
lines.show: Which devil fruit should I draw next? Comment below!
